title: clearance's read_attempts counts the same over either trace store
intention: CodeMother's clearance proves at its own address that read_attempts counts the same over a legacy-named trace store and a new-name store, so the claim stays proved when learning_block stops measuring it.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: the claim is proved only by clause 4 of learning_block's test_a_trace_file_name_is_legal_on_every_box (ticket a9709b744bf5), whose _counts() imports cairn.devices.codemother.machines.clearance and calls read_attempts. That is a machine's proof reaching into a device (RULE 1: a proof measures only its own component). No `cairn codemother` verb answers read_attempts (root list codemother/cross/harbor_master/question/seed/show/watch; harbor_master views status/settings/map/traffic), so the orchestrator ruled the claim proved at its owner.
traces_to: RULE 1 (a proof measures only its own component) and Law 8 (a proof a hollow build couldn't pass).
how: One proof under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/ seeds the harbor_master:clearance block in a scratch CAIRN_LB_TRACE_ROOT under the legacy name, under the new name, and under both, then holds read_attempts' attempts and unreadable_lines. On Windows the legacy name comes through learning_block's legacy_trace_path seam. No code changes.

clauses.claim: over a legacy-only store and a new-name-only store, read_attempts returns the same attempts (one granted, one refused) and the same unreadable_lines (1)
with both the legacy and the new-name file present, read_attempts returns the legacy file's attempts first, then the new one's, and counts one unreadable line per file

decisions.text: D1: the proof binds read_attempts at call time and seeds each store in its own scratch root; the Windows legacy name comes through the legacy_trace_path seam, as in the learning_block proof. One tooth per clause.

measured.saw: the only proof of the clearance reader's either-store count is learning_block's clause 4, importing cairn.devices.codemother.machines.clearance
measured.how: grep -rn read_attempts over cairn/: callers are clearance's own probes and the learning_block proof

measured.saw: no cairn codemother verb or harbor_master view answers read_attempts
measured.how: cairn codemother list; cairn codemother harbor_master list

measured.saw: the new proof green 2/2 over the code that stands; red on both teeth when trace_lines is replaced by a hand read of trace_path only
measured.how: bin/cairn test --exec in worktree wt-clr; an in-process hollow patch of clearance.trace_lines
